title: KSI Evidence Record
description: One machine-readable evidence record for a single FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicator (KSI). A record captures where the evidence came from, when it was collected, and a true/false/null validation result. Field semantics follow the public FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026 KSI reference: https://www.fedramp.gov/2026/reference/key-security-indicators/

ksi_id.description: KSI identifier as published by FedRAMP, for example KSI-IAM-APM.

statement.description: The KSI statement verbatim from fedramp.gov. Kept with the record so a reviewer does not need to cross-reference.

class.description: FedRAMP 20x authorization class the record is evaluated against. CR26 defines 20x Class A, B and C.

evidence_type.description: How the evidence was obtained. Automated types (api_query, config_export, log_query) are preferred. manual is allowed but should be the exception.

source.description: Where the evidence came from. Generic on purpose: no provider-specific identifiers belong here.

system.description: Logical name of the system queried, for example identity-provider, iac-state, siem, asset-inventory.

query.description: The query, API call, or export command that produced the evidence, in enough detail to re-run it.

artifact_uri.description: Optional pointer to the raw evidence artifact (object store, ticket, etc).

artifact_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the raw artifact so the evidence can be integrity-checked later.

collected_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) of when the evidence was collected.

result.description: true: evidence shows the KSI is met. false: evidence shows it is not met. null: the evidence could not be collected or evaluated. A null result is not a pass and is not neutral; under VDR-CSO-FAV a failure of the detection process is itself a finding.

rationale.description: Short, reviewer-facing explanation of why the result is what it is. Required whenever result is false or null.

owner.description: Role or team accountable for this KSI. A role name, not a person.

related_800_53_controls.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control identifiers the KSI maps to, as listed on fedramp.gov. Lowercase, with enhancements written as parent.enhancement (ia-2.1).

next_collection_due.description: Optional. When the next automated collection is expected. Supports the persistent validation expectation.
